label: Square POS state
description: What the app remembers between runs, one record per kind: the claim of the sync that is running, the webhook it registered with Square, how far the search for sales has come, and the result of the last product match.

owner.label: Run
owner.description: On the claim: the run that holds it.

date_heartbeat.label: Last sign of life
date_heartbeat.description: On the claim: renewed by the run while it works. A claim without a recent one is taken over.

address.label: Webhook address
address.description: The address as registered with Square. Its signature covers it.

cursor.label: Sales read up to
cursor.description: The time of change up to which Square's orders have been read.

date_from.label: Sales imported from
date_from.description: Sales completed earlier are not imported, even when Square changes them later: the time the import was switched on, or the date of Import past sales.

enabled_at.label: Import switched on
enabled_at.description: The enable boundary applied by the workflow. A new boundary in the settings starts a new search, without other functions changing search progress.

search.label: Search for new sales
search.description: A search of Square's orders that has not been read to its end: its time range, locations and Square's cursor.

past.label: Search for past sales
past.description: The search started by Import past sales, while it has not been read to its end.

requested.label: Search requested
requested.description: Set by a payment or refund notice, cleared when a run searches Square's orders.

swell_location.label: Swell stock location
swell_location.description: On the store record: the name set under Inventory, as it was last looked up.
